ia_X-Play.2008.08.11.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review of Madden NFL 09, as well as an incredible Preview of EA's highly anticipated survival horror title, Dead Space. Also, Mr. Sark will bringing you an All Access look at Bionic Commando Rearmed and we'll unveil a new segment, The Will Wright Minute.

ia_X-Play.2008.08.12.s: Adam and Morgan bring you a Preview of Dark Void, as well as an incredible All Access look at id Software's highly anticipated FPS title, Wolfenstein. Also, we'll have a Hands On demo with Rise of the Argonauts.

ia_X-Play.2008.08.13.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for the Sci-Fi RPG Space Siege for the PC, as well as an incredible All Access look at the highly anticipated MMO title, Warhammer Online: Age of Reckoning. Also, we'll have the latest available for digital delivery as we explore The Download with Bionic Commando Rearmed.

ia_X-Play.2008.08.14.s: Adam and Morgan devote a full episode to bringing you an early look at LucasArts highly anticipating action game Star Wars: The Force Unleashed. We'll have an All Access interview with Project Lead Hayden Blackman, as well as behind-the-scenes specials on the art, music, and tech of the eagerly awaited next chapter in the Star Wars Saga.

ia_X-Play.2008.08.18.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for the EA sports title Madden NFL 09 All-Play for the Nintendo Wii, as well as two incredible Previews for the highly anticipated shooters, Far Cry 2 and Crysis Warhead. Also, our favorite eccentric video gamer creator/guru is back with his take on 2001 in The Will Wright Minute NOTE: Adam is not in this episode.

ia_X-Play.2008.08.19.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for the highly anticipated action-RPG Too Human, as well as an incredible Preview for the upcoming voice-activated RTS, Tom Clancy's EndWar. Also, we'll get an incredible Hands On look at Disney Interactive's beautiful upcoming ATV racing title, Pure. NOTE: Adam is not in this episode.

ia_X-Play.2008.10.14.s: Several heroes stand at major crossroads, facing personal decisions that could redefine who's "good" or "evil" -Claire attempts to take down her first new villain. Originally aired October 14, 2008.

ia_X-Play.Fall.Out.3.Special.s: Adam and Morgan continue their World Premiere Tuesdays by bringing you an in-depth look at the highly anticipated RPG title, Fallout 3. We'll bring you Exclusive footage, as well as interviews with Fallout 3 mastermind Todd Howard and the entire Bethesda team. World Premiere Tuesdays continue tonight! Originally aired October 14, 2008.

ia_X-Play.2008.10.20.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their Reviews for three of the most highly anticipated titles of the year, including Fable II, LittleBigPlanet, and Dead Space, as well as an All Access look at the upcoming parkour-inspired first-person action title from EA, Mirror's Edge. Also, Kristin Holt will be back with some more tips and tricks of the force in Star Wars: The Force Unleashed.

ia_X-Play.2008.10.27.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their All Access reports for three of the most highly anticipated titles of the year, including Prince of Persia, Left 4 Dead, and the Fallout 3 Launch Party, as well as a Hands On with Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe. Also, Kristin Holt will be back with some more tips and tricks as she tells you have to have fun with pedestrians in Saints Row 2.

ia_X-Play.2008.10.29.s: Adam and Morgan bring you two major Reviews with their scores for Fallout 3 and MotorStorm: Pacific Rift. They'll also get some Face Time with the legendary Shigeru Miyamoto and give you part 2 of their All Access look at Prince of Persia. Finally, they will bring you the Broadcast Premiere of the amazing new Killzone 2 trailer.

ia_X-Play.2008.10.30.s: Adam and Morgan bring you their Review for Midnight Club: Los Angeles, as well as a Hands On with the highly-anticipated Tomb Raider: Underworld, while they stay Up All Night with Warhammer Online. Games in 60 Seconds will take a look at the classic: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas and Cliff Bleszinski will stop by with an all-new Cliff Notes.

ia_X-Play.2008.11.05.s: Adam and Morgan bring you Reviews for Resistance 2 and Guitar Hero: World Tour, as well as the second part of our interview with Miyamoto in Face Time. Also, we take another All Access look at the new Prince of Persia game.

ia_X-Play.2008.11.06.s: Survivors fear that "The Others" may have returned when Sun is injured during a failed kidnapping attempt. Meanwhile, Sawyer is an amused, but highly interested, bystander when tension escalates between Jack, Locke, Kate and Ana Lucia over control of the hatch computer, and the storage of the weapons.

ia_X-Play.2008.11.25.s: ProTip w/ Tsquared; Preview-Zero Punctuation; Preview-Upcoming Game

ia_X-Play.2008.11.26.s: Gaming Update-Latest News; Preview-Upcoming Game; Review-Latest Game

ia_X-Play.2011.01.24.s: Adam and Morgan review World of Warcraft: Cataclym, go hands-on with Dead Space 2, and weigh in on new DLC for Fallout: New Vegas. After a 10-word review of Red Dead Redemption, they explain for all time our 5-star rating system. They'll rival AOTS' new billboard campaign using 1% of the budget, and eavesdrop on employees who think they're alone. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.01.25.s: Adam and Morgan get previews of Marvel vs. Capcom 3's new characters and the new storyline in Uncharted 3, and also take a look at Dead Space 2's multiplayer. They'll get face time with Cliff Bleszinski to discuss Gears of War 3, and then deliver their review of Super Mario All-Stars. Finally, Assassin's Creed II gets the Games In 6 Seconds treatment. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.01.26.s: Adam and Morgan review the return of Sackboy in LittleBigPlanet 2, then render verdicts on Battlefield: Bad Company 2 Vietnam and Dead Rising 2: Case West. They'll also get some pro tips straight from Bungie for Halo: Reach's Tempest map, and get early looks at Marvel vs. Capcom 3 and the hotly anticipated Nintendo 3DS. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.01.31.s: Adam and Morgan review Dead Space 2, Lost In Shadow, Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective, and Echochrome 2. They'll get a story preview of upcoming shooter Homefront, and go hands-on with Double Fine's nearly-here Stacking. They'll also run down some of their favorites for the iPhone and iPad, and get in a 10-words-or-less review of Splatterhouse. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.02.s: Adam and Morgan review DC Universe Online and go hands-on with the upcoming and returning-to-violent-form Mortal Kombat. They'll also preview the biggest console-exclusive titles coming down the 2011 pipe, and deliver reviews for the PlayStation Eye-powered Kung Fu Live and Xbox Live Arcade's tea-time charmer ilomilo. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.07.s: Adam and Morgan celebrate Blizzard Entertainment's 20th Anniversary with interviews and pro tips and news galore. Then they'll preview Homefront's multiplayer and the characters in Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Fate of Two Worlds, list off the cheapest thrills in gaming right now, and let you know if the new Call of Duty: Black Ops DLC First Strike is worth the cash. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.08.s: Adam and Morgan get hands-on early looks at DiRT 3 and the PvP for Diablo III. They'll also review action shooter Killzone 3 and multiplayer shooter Breach. Then, they reveal their favorite 5 LBP2 user-created levels, and Blizzard's Tom Chilton stops by to reveal why he thinks the World of Warcraft franchise has been able to achieve such astounding success. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.09.s: Adam and Morgan get big previews of Homefront's combat play, Diablo III, and WWE All-Stars. They'll also take a look at three great games that aren't getting the love they deserve, visit with Blizzard's Tom Chilton for some pro tips on mastering the giant universe of WoW: Cataclysm, and bring in Casey Schreiner for the latest MMO news on The MMO Report. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.15.s: Morgan and Blair review Mass Effect 2 for PS3, then preview RIFT and the multiplayer mode in Crysis 2. They'll hear from Sims and Spore creator Will Wright on his new forays into TV, and uncover lost audition tapes for characters rejected from MvC3. Finally, you think Dead Space 2 is scary? It's even scarier in the ultimate room we created to play it in. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.17.s: Blair and Morgan get huge previews of Duke Nukem Forever, Red Faction Armageddon, and top Nintendo 3DS launch titles. They'll also look at the hard numbers around the complaint that gaming just gets more and more expensive, get in a review of Lord Arcana, and look at our final audition tape of rejected MvC3 characters. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.21.s: X-Play travels to Epic Games for a behind-the-scenes look at Bulletstorm, the brand-new First Person Shooter from EA and legendary Gears of War game designer Cliff Bleszinski. Adam and Morgan get previews of story, weapons, kills, and so much more. Full Metal Jacket's R. Lee Ermey even shows up! X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.22.s: Adam and Morgan have big reviews of Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Fate of Two Worlds, Test Drive 2 Unlimited, and Tim Schafer's new downloadable puzzler Stacking. They'll also get face time with Ubisoft's Jade Raymond, go on location at the Indie Games Challenge for a look at the best in indie games, and get an early look at the upcoming Total War: Shogun 2. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.02.23.s: Adam and Morgan review bloody new FPS Bulletstorm, and get creator Cliff Bleszinski to reveal some stuff that was just too bloody even for them. They'll also get Insomniac's Ted Price to reveal his take on the year in gaming in a Face Time segment. After a review of Two Worlds 2, they'll go behind the scenes with Homefront Sr. Level Designer Zach Wilson. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.03.07.s: Adam and Morgan deliver reviews of de Blob 2 and EA Sports' Fight Night Champion, and go hands-on with the combat tools of Deus Ex: Human Revolution. They'll also go on location with star Felicia Day on the live-action web series Dragon Age: Redemption, get face time with FarmVille Chief Game Designer Brian Reynolds, and respond to viewer mail. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.03.16.s: Adam and Morgan bring you day 2 of our PAX East blow out! They get previews from the show floor of SW: The Old Republic, F.E.A.R. 3, Magic: The Gathering - Duels of the Planeswalkers 2012, RAGE, and the Nintendo 3DS. They visit nearby Harmonix, creator of Dance Central. Finally, they roam the show halls asking fans what makes the perfect game. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm!

ia_X-Play.2011.03.17.s: Adam and Morgan bring you day 3 of PAX East coverage, with big previews from the show floor of Mortal Kombat, Orcs Must Die, Lord of the Rings Online, D&D Online, Brink, and Hunted: The Demon's Forge. They'll also scout the show's best in table top gaming, visit the directors of Indie Game: The Movie, and talk with the PAX folks who make it all happen. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm!

ia_X-Play.2011.03.19.s: XPLAY All Access takes you inside the PAX East convention in Boston for all the latest videogame news and previews. Hosted by Adam Sessler, Morgan Webb and Blair Herter.

ia_X-Play.2011.03.22.s: Adam and Morgan get big early looks at The Gunstringer, Ratchet & Clank: All 4 One, and free-to-play MMO Age of Empires Online. They'll also review MLB 11: The Show as well as two different peripherals that will turn your PlayStation Move controller into a gun. Then, they'll look at some of their favorite user-generated levels for LittleBigPlanet 2. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.03.23.s: Adam and Morgan take an early look at Microsoft's biggest gaming titles coming in 2011, and go hands-on with the about-to-release Nintendo 3DS. They'll also review first-person shooter Homefront and take a look at some of the best free PC games currently out there. Finally, Aaron Eckart will stop by for some face time to talk Battle: Los Angeles. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!

ia_X-Play.2011.03.28.s: Adam and Morgan review Torchlight and Dissidia 012: Duodecim Final Fantasy, then get early looks at Dungeon Siege 3 and free-to-play shooter Firefall. They'll also get face time with Irrational Games' Ken Levine, and pro tips for Killzone 3's multiplayer. Then, Videogame Deathmatch is back, and this time it's franchises that will be fighting to the death. X-Play starts tonight at 6:30pm ET!
